Across the first four seasons of Betway SA20, Ryan Rickelton has established himself as a record-breaker for MI Cape Town!
1,349 runs - The leading run-scorer in SA20 history.
117 fours - The most fours hit by any player in SA20 history.
81 sixes - Joint-most in SA20 history, sharing the record with Dewald Brevis from Pretoria Capitals.
From consistent run-scoring to finding the boundary and clearing the ropes, relive some of Rickelton's best batting moments from the past four seasons.
